system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 4 lbs. Power Points 26; Recharge 3 per day.

Roots coil naturally around the shaft of this living staff. Small patches of fungus appear, fruit and disappear according to the terrain through which the bearer travels.

While wielding the staff, you gain a +1-item bonus to Nature checks involving spirits, fungi or natural spiritual phenomena.

Activate Cast a Spell; Effect You expend the required PP to cast a spell from its list.

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed spells at the indicated PP cost

Spells: Fungal Ward (2 PP), Memory of Stone (4 PP), Mycelial Message (4 PP), Breath of the Land (6 PP), Rooted Soul (10 PP).

On the sheet: a staff: its five spells are cast from the item's PP; +1 item is offered on Nature about spirits and fungi while it is held.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

conditionals.label: Staff of Spirit Roads
conditionals.scope: Nature checks involving spirits, fungi or natural spiritual phenomena
